usage.result_excerpt:
I wrote the solution to `main.wj`. It compiled with `wj run --compiled` and matched Example 2 exactly. I did not run Example 1 or any other inputs.

It builds a sieve of Eratosthenes up to 200000 once. It also stores, for every `n`, the prime count and the largest prime at or below it. Each query is then a table lookup. Any `n` below 2 prints `0 none`.

The build printed some unused-import and unn
